title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Boch Center, Boston | 2022
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Wang Theater, part of the Boch Center in Boston, Massachusetts, USA, on 2 June 2022.

It was the fourth show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2022 tour of North America, which lasted for 30 dates between May and October 2022.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
